name: interior-decision-board
description: 부부를 위한 인테리어 소스 수집 및 공동 의사결정 보드

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @interior/server" "npm run dev -w @interior/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @interior/shared && npm run build -w @interior/server && npm run build -w @interior/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @interior/shared && npm run typecheck -w @interior/server && npm run typecheck -w @interior/web
